entries.title: Your first mate moves on iPhone and iPad as it does on the Mac
entries.body: On iPhone and iPad your first mate now drifts, blinks and looks around at rest, and glows hot with a halo while it works, just as on the Mac. It greets you when the app opens or joins a computer, and nods when your first mate nods on the Mac.

picture.alt: Infinitary on iPhone shows the first mate at work above "No cards to read yet.": an amber tesseract with glowing wires, a soft halo and two white-hot eyes.
